text: Mustafa Selcuk tbh i was the first person from KOSOVO that applied for the visa of going in the way of temporary residency, it wasn’t even on the registration of the online application I had to go and ask them to add my country in the application , so I think they are not recognising the documents because is something they haven’t dealt with before 🤷🏻‍♀️ 🤷🏻‍♀️ Tomorrow I will upload them again then I will have 1 more week from them to see what they have to say about it , I just feel like I am losing patience with all of this situation, it feels like trapped, haven’t traveled back to my family haven’t seen anyone for almost 9 month , never lived abroad before , I can’t work , I can’t do nothing 🙏🏼
